// internal/distributed/proxy/httpserver/request_v2.go line 491-513
type SearchReqV2 struct {
	DbName            string                 `json:"dbName"`
	CollectionName    string                 `json:"collectionName" binding:"required"`
	Data              []interface{}          `json:"data"`
	Ids               []interface{}          `json:"ids"`
	AnnsField         string                 `json:"annsField"`
	PartitionNames    []string               `json:"partitionNames"`
	Filter            string                 `json:"filter"`
	GroupByField      string                 `json:"groupingField"`  // ← BUG: JSON tag is 'groupingField' not 'groupByField'
	GroupSize         int32                  `json:"groupSize"`
	StrictGroupSize   bool                   `json:"strictGroupSize"`
	Limit             int32                  `json:"limit"`
	Offset            int32                  `json:"offset"`
	OutputFields      []string               `json:"outputFields"`
	SearchParams      map[string]interface{} `json:"searchParams"`
	ConsistencyLevel  string                 `json:"consistencyLevel"`
	ExprParams        map[string]interface{} `json:"exprParams"`
	FunctionScore     FunctionScore          `json:"functionScore"`
	FunctionChains    []FunctionChainReq     `json:"functionChains"`
	SearchAggregation *SearchAggregationReq  `json:"searchAggregation"`
	Params            map[string]float64      `json:"params"`
}

// internal/distributed/proxy/httpserver/handler_v2.go line 1926-1932
// Code DOES process GroupByField when correctly bound:
if httpReq.GroupByField != "" {
	searchParams = append(searchParams, &commonpb.KeyValuePair{Key: ParamGroupByField, Value: httpReq.GroupByField})
}
if httpReq.GroupByField != "" && httpReq.GroupSize > 0 {
	searchParams = append(searchParams, &commonpb.KeyValuePair{Key: ParamGroupSize, Value: strconv.FormatInt(int64(httpReq.GroupSize), 10)})
	searchParams = append(searchParams, &commonpb.KeyValuePair{Key: ParamStrictGroupSize, Value: strconv.FormatBool(httpReq.StrictGroupSize)})
}
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: SearchReqV2.GroupByField JSON tag mismatch → request binding ignores 'groupByField' → grouping parameters never processed → search executes without grouping
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:JSON标签不匹配(struct字段GroupByField的JSON tag是'groupingField'而非'groupByField'),导致请求中的groupByField参数未被正确解析,分组功能被静默忽略.当使用正确的字段名'groupingField'时,API会返回错误提示'unsupported data type VECTOR_FLOAT for group by operator',证明分组逻辑确实存在但参数名错误.

falsification.observed: Using correct field 'groupingField': API properly processes request and returns error 'unsupported data type VECTOR_FLOAT for group by operator at SearchGroupByOperator.cpp:169'. This proves: (1) grouping logic IS implemented in the codebase, (2) the only issue is JSON field name mismatch, (3) vector fields cannot be used for grouping (by design limitation).

verdicts.rationale: 源码接地确认:SearchReqV2结构体中GroupByField字段的JSON标签为'groupingField'(含ing后缀),但REST API文档和实际请求使用'groupByField'(无ing),导致参数绑定失败,分组功能被静默忽略.实测证明:使用正确字段名'groupingField'时API能正确处理分组请求(尽管因VECTOR_FLOAT类型限制返回错误),说明问题纯粹是JSON字段名不匹配而非功能缺失.这属于REST v2 API数据类型序列化问题的经典模式(bug_shape:rest-v2-data-type-handling),维护者明确将此类问题视为缺陷(26 historical instances).影响:用户无法通过REST v2 API使用分组功能,请求成功但结果不符合预期,严重违反API语义契约.
